newsitem.title: UK: Odds lengthen on Conservative win - UK bookmakers.
newsitem.headline: Odds lengthen on Conservative win - UK bookmakers.

text.p: Odds on the ruling Conservatives winning the May 1 election have lengthened to 9-2 from 4-1 while Labour are quoted as 1-8 favourites, bookmakers Ladbrokes said on Wednesday.
The odds on the centrist Liberal Democrats have lengthened to 800-1 from 600-1. Ladbrokes said they had not struck a bet on John Major's Conservatives for more than two weeks.

Odds on overall Labour victory by number of seats is as follows: 1-20 -- 10-1; 21-40 -- 6-1 (from 3-1); 41-60 -- 7-2; 61-80 -- 5-1; 81-100 -- 6-1 (7-1); 101-120 -- 8-1 (9-1); 121 or more -- 9-2. A hung parliament is quoted at 4-1.
